newsitem.title: POLAND: UNIVERSAL SEES 97 PRE-TAX UP TO PLN 35 MLN.
newsitem.headline: UNIVERSAL SEES 97 PRE-TAX UP TO PLN 35 MLN.

text.p: Polish trader Universal SA expects its pre-tax profit to rise to 35 million zlotys this year from 30.9 million zlotys in 1996, the firm's president said in the Thursday edition of the daily Parkiet.
Dariusz Przywieczerski also told the paper that group pre-tax profit would rise to 70 million zlotys.
The company has not published group results for 1996 but said in November that it expected a group net of 47 million zlotys for 1996 and 60 million zlotys for 1997 against 19.4 million in 1995.
The parent company netted 23.3 million zlotys last year against 12 million zlotys in 1995.
Parkiet also said Universal was interested in buying the Romet bicycle maker, to whom its 25-percent owned subsidiary Datus imports parts.

"We're still interested in buying Zaklady Rowerowe Romet in (the northern town of) Bydgosdzcz. Everything depends on the price at which the treasury ministry will want to sell the firm," Parkiet quoted Przywieczerski as saying.
The paper said Datus planned to import around $11 million in parts this year made by the Japanese firm Shimano .
